name: Saint Kitts and Nevis
summary: St. Kitts and Nevis has had no personal income tax since 1980 and has no inheritance, estate, gift or wealth tax. Capital gains are untaxed unless the asset is sold within one year of purchase (then at most 20% under the Income Tax Act). Dividends are not taxed for residents. Real estate transfers bear 6-10% seller stamp duty and a 10% alien landholding licence for non-resident buyers. Citizenship by investment from USD 250,000 (Sustainable Island State Contribution).

regimes.name: Ordinary residence
regimes.description: No personal income tax; no estate or wealth taxes.
regimes.eligibility: Any lawful resident; non-citizens need a residence permit or citizenship.

capital_gains.summary: No tax on gains from assets held more than one year. Gains on assets sold within a year of purchase are taxed at the lower of half the effective corporate rate or 20%.
capital_gains.rate_basis: Long-held assets: 0 (Deloitte 2026: capital gains not taxed unless the asset is sold within one year). Individuals pay no income tax (IRD).

sources.title: Deloitte International Tax: St. Kitts and Nevis Highlights 2026 (updated January 2026)
St. Kitts and Nevis Inland Revenue Department: Corporate Income Tax ('Income tax on individuals was abolished in 1980')
sources.publisher: Inland Revenue Department, St. Kitts and Nevis

open_questions: Whether the one-year short-term capital gains rule applies to individuals.
capital_gains.holding_period_rules: Short-term rule (sale within one year): lower of 50% of the effective CIT rate or 20%. Deloitte states it in the corporate section; whether it reaches individuals after the 1980 abolition of individual income tax is unclear.
capital_gains.important_exceptions: Stamp duty on transfers of real property 6%-10% depending on consideration and location, payable by the seller; non-resident purchasers need an alien landholding licence costing the greater of 10% of value or XCD 750. Share transfers: 2% stamp duty paid by the seller.
capital_gains.regional_differences: Nevis has its own Island Administration and legislation for some fees and stamp duties; not researched.

dividends.summary: No tax on dividends received by resident individuals.

sources.title: Deloitte International Tax: St. Kitts and Nevis Highlights 2026 (updated January 2026)

dividends.withholding_outbound: 0% to residents; 15% to non-residents (treaty reductions possible).
dividends.treaty_network: IRD lists double taxation relief orders for Canada, Denmark, Monaco, New Zealand, Norway, San Marino, Sweden, Switzerland, UK and US, plus the CARICOM treaty; Deloitte cites more than 10 treaties. Benefit for a resident individual's portfolio WHT not verified.

wealth_tax.property_tax_note: Property tax 0.2%-0.3% of market value depending on use and location; one-year exemption for new homes.

sources.title: Deloitte International Tax: St. Kitts and Nevis Highlights 2026 (updated January 2026)

inheritance.summary: No inheritance or estate tax; no gift tax.
inheritance.gift_tax: No gift tax; stamp duty on any transfer instrument for land may apply (rate on gifts not verified).

sources.title: Deloitte International Tax: St. Kitts and Nevis Highlights 2026 (updated January 2026)

open_questions: Stamp duty on gifts or inheritance of land to children.

residency.tax_residency_test: No personal income tax. Individuals registered with the IRD or who are CBI citizens must file a final return and get a clearance certificate when emigrating (Deloitte).

routes.name: Citizenship: Sustainable Island State Contribution
routes.requirements: USD 250,000 for a main applicant or family of up to four, plus USD 25,000 per extra dependant under 18 and USD 50,000 per extra dependant 18+. Due diligence USD 10,000 main applicant, USD 7,500 per dependant 16+. Interview for main applicants and dependants 16+ if required. Not accepted from Afghanistan, Belarus, Iran, Iraq, North Korea, Russia. From 14 April 2026 all CBI citizens must enrol in biometric passport programme (deadline 31 July 2027).

routes.name: Citizenship: real estate
routes.requirements: Developer real estate USD 325,000 or approved private home USD 600,000, not resold for 7 years; post-approval fees USD 25,000 main applicant, 15,000 spouse, 10,000 per child under 18.

routes.name: Citizenship: Public Benefit Option
routes.requirements: USD 250,000 in an approved public project.

corporate.summary: Corporate income tax 25%; short-term capital gains (asset held under one year) at the lower of half the CIT rate or 20%; no participation exemption; companies doing business exclusively abroad generally not taxed. No Pillar Two commitment. 15% WHT on dividends to non-residents.

prime_rent_monthly.description: Single listing (n=1): the only 4-5 bedroom house with a stated rent among Caribbean Paradise Realty's St Kitts long-term (one year or more) house rentals on 15 Oct 2026, a fully furnished 4-bedroom, 4-bath house with ocean views in Half Moon Heights (ref. SKBHR30), USD 3,000 a month including WiFi, cable, water and yard maintenance. The other priced houses on the page were 2-3 bedrooms (USD 1,500-2,500). Thin sample; treat as indicative.

source.title: Caribbean Paradise Realty: St Kitts rentals, houses (leases of one year or more)

intl_school_annual_fee.description: St. Kitts International Academy (private K-12, US-curriculum high school through partner schools), Grades 11 & 12 annual fee for expatriates (non-St Kitts and Nevis passport holders), 2025-2026, books and materials included; Grades 9-10 XCD 24,380; local rate XCD 20,140. Plus a XCD 200 annual registration fee; high-school fees may rise for additional classes. 2026-27 fees not published on the page.

source.title: St. Kitts International Academy: School fees (tuition schedule 2024-2025 and 2025-2026)

cost_of_living.notes: Purchase price per m2, health insurance and housekeeper not sourced.

us_citizen_notes: US citizens stay subject to US federal tax on worldwide income, gains and estate; with no local income tax there is no local tax to credit, so the US layer applies in full.
open_questions: Effective date of current CBI minimums and any 2025-2026 price changes or regional (Eastern Caribbean) regulator rules not verified; the December 2025 Chairman's Update PDF was not read.
Prime rent rests on a single 4-bedroom listing (Caribbean Paradise Realty, Half Moon Heights, USD 3,000 a month); a wider sample of Frigate Bay / Ocean's Edge / Nevis long lets would firm it up.
